label: Every existent at the selected world is CONCRETE_6
paraphrase: At the selected world w, every candidate that exists at w satisfies the profile's concreteness predicate (CogitoEsse.EveryExistentConcreteAt on the profile's Ontic and concrete). It does not classify candidates absent from w and does not exclude abstract candidates from the carrier; it says that none of them exists at w in the profile's sense of existence, which the existence-to-act contract reads as existence in re. It contradicts the recorded rival 'Some actual concretum has a distinct existing cause of its esse that is not CONCRETE_6', whose cause exists at w and is not concrete. Since only esse-in-re to concrete is assumed, the conclusion also holds for a trivially broad concrete predicate; excluding abstracta from m.concrete needs the unstated converse.
